items.title: LEGO Amazing Earth
items.description: A whistle-stop tour of the most amazing features and places on planet Earth, illustrated with LEGO models, including tips for budding LEGO builders Explore our amazing planet-and learn to build the most incredible things on Earth! There is so much to see on planet Earth. From the rainforest canopy to the deepest depths of the Pacific Ocean, discover plants, animals, and the geological features that make up our planet. Travel the continents and look inside volcanoes, mountains, geysers, and much more. Visit the Amazon, check out the world's tallest waterfall, and explore the most incredible places on the planet without leaving home. With more than 100 LEGO models to inspire you, what on Earth will you build?

items.title: 12 Days of Christmas (LEGO)
items.description: Join in a super-silly Christmas celebration based on an all-new LEGO® holiday song! The holiday season can get a little kooky—especially when LEGO® friends come to visit. Get ready for Christmas with an ever-growing cast of merry guests, including festive robots and pirates. Inspired by an all-new video that puts a silly LEGO® spin on “The Twelve Days of Christmas,” this full-color hardcover picture book is sure to thrill boys and girls ages 3 to 7—and collectors of all ages. items.title: The Invincible Iron Man (Marvel: Iron Man)
items.description: Clad in invincible armor, Iron Man is always ready to rocket to the rescue. Boys and girls ages 2 to 5 can leap into the action with this heavy-duty hero to learn all about his amazing armor and most fearsome foes in the first ever Iron Man Little Golden Book!

items.title: Christmas Party
items.description: Join the rabbit children as they enlist an older friend to help surprise their parents with the most beautiful Christmas party. There isn’t much that can convince Orson Abott to escape the quiet and secluded space of his treehouse. But when he climbs down into the holiday spirit one afternoon, a group of younger rabbits request the help of Orson as they put together a surprise Christmas party for their parents, and Orson can’t resist being the leader. “The story is warm and funny, graced by the most radiant paintings in full color, pictures that convey the excitement, tenderness, and mystery of the holiday.” – Publishers Weekly
